questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the mother of C. What is A's relation to C?
questions.explanation:
A is B's father. B is C's mother.
A is one generation above B, who is C's parent.
A is C's grandfather.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the daughter of B. B is the mother of C. What is A's relation to C?
questions.explanation:
B has two children: A (daughter) and C.
Both A and C are B's children → A and C are siblings.
A is C's sister.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the son of B. B is the brother of C. C is the mother of D. What is A's relation to D?
questions.explanation:
B is A's father. C is B's sister → B and C are siblings.
C is D's mother. B is D's uncle.
A is D's uncle's son → A and D are cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Ravi, pointing to a woman in a photo, says: "She is the daughter of my father's only son." How is the woman related to Ravi?
questions.explanation:
Ravi's father's only son = Ravi himself (only son).
She is the daughter of Ravi.
The woman is Ravi's daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A says to B: "Your father is the only son of my grandfather." How is A related to B?
questions.explanation:
A's grandfather's only son = A's father.
B's father = A's father → A and B have the same father.
A is B's brother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the father-in-law of B. B is the mother of C. What is A's relation to C?
questions.explanation:
A is B's father-in-law → A's child married B.
B is C's mother → C is the child of A's child.
A is C's grandfather.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A's father is B. B's sister is C. C's son is D. What is D's relation to A?
questions.explanation:
B is A's father. C is B's sister → C is A's aunt.
D is C's son → D is the son of A's aunt.
D is A's cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman says: "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation:
My mother's only daughter = the woman herself.
Man's mother = the woman.
The woman is the man's mother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the brother of B. B is the son of C. D is the uncle of A. How is D related to C?
questions.explanation:
B is C's son. A is B's brother → A is also C's son.
D is A's uncle → D is the brother of one of A's parents.
Since A is C's son, D is C's brother.
D is C's brother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a code, A + B means A is the father of B; A − B means A is the wife of B. If P + Q − R, what is P's relation to R?
questions.explanation:
P + Q → P is Q's father.
Q − R → Q is R's wife → R is Q's husband.
P is Q's father. R is Q's husband.
P is R's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man says: "She is the wife of the only son of my father." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation:
Man's father's only son = the man himself (he is the only son).
She is the wife of the man.
The woman is the man's wife.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A's mother's brother is B. B has only one daughter, C. What is A's relation to C?
questions.explanation:
B is A's maternal uncle. C is B's daughter.
A is the child of B's sister (A's mother). C is B's own daughter.
A and C are the children of siblings → A and C are cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: D is the brother of A. A is the father of E. What is D's relation to E?
questions.explanation:
A is E's father. D is A's brother.
D is the brother of E's father.
D is E's uncle.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A's father is B. B's mother is C. D is C's only son. What is D's relation to A?
questions.explanation:
B is C's son. D is also C's son but C has only one son.
Therefore D = B.
B is A's father, so D is A's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman says: "His mother is the wife of my father's son." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation:
Woman's father's son = the woman's brother.
Man's mother is the woman's brother's wife.
Man is the son of the woman's brother.
The woman is the man's aunt.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a code, X @ Y means X is the father of Y; X # Y means X is the brother of Y. In the expression X @ Y # Z, what is X's relation to Z?
questions.explanation:
X @ Y → X is Y's father.
Y # Z → Y is Z's brother.
X is Y's father. Y and Z are siblings (both children of X).
X is Z's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A and B are married. A's mother is C. C has only one son, D. D has a daughter E. How is E related to B?
questions.explanation:
C has only one son = D. A is C's child, so D = A.
E is A's daughter. A and B are married.
E is B's daughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pooja says to Ravi: "My father's mother is your father's mother." How is Pooja related to Ravi?
questions.explanation:
Both Pooja and Ravi share the same paternal grandmother.
This means Pooja's father and Ravi's father are brothers.
Pooja and Ravi are cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A's mother is B. B's husband is C. C's father is D. D's wife is E. How is E related to A?
questions.explanation:
B is A's mother. C is B's husband = A's father.
D is C's father = A's paternal grandfather.
E is D's wife = A's paternal grandmother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man points to a photo and says: "He is the son of my father's only son." How is the man related to the person in the photo?
questions.explanation:
Man's father's only son = the man himself.
The person in the photo is the man's son.
The man is the photo person's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the mother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. D is the son of E. What is A's relation to E?
questions.explanation:
A is B's mother. B is C's sister → A is C's mother.
C is D's father. E is D's mother (D is the son of C and E).
C is married to E. A is C's mother.
A is E's mother-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Rahul says, pointing to a girl: "Her father is the only son of my mother's husband." How is Rahul related to the girl?
questions.explanation:
Rahul's mother's husband = Rahul's father.
Rahul's father's only son = Rahul himself.
Girl's father = Rahul.
Rahul is the girl's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a code, A + B means A is the father of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A * B means A is the wife of B. In the expression P + Q − R * S, what is P's relation to S?
questions.explanation:
P + Q → P is Q's father.
Q − R → Q is R's brother (Q male, R female siblings).
R * S → R is S's wife → S is R's husband.
P is the father of Q and R. R is married to S.
P is S's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the grandfather of B. B is the brother of C. D is the mother of C. What is A's relation to D?
questions.explanation:
A is B's grandfather. B is C's brother → A is also C's grandfather.
D is C's mother. A's son is C's (and B's) father.
D is married to A's son.
A is D's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Anita says: "The man in this photo is the husband of the granddaughter of my maternal grandfather's only child." How is the man related to Anita?
questions.explanation:
Anita's maternal grandfather's only child = Anita's mother.
Granddaughter of Anita's mother = Anita's daughter.
The man is the husband of Anita's daughter.
The man is Anita's son-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning
